faq_heading: Homes near Chimney Hill Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Chimney Hill Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Chimney Hill Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Chimney Hill Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Chimney Hill Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 50 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,480,000, townhomes $717,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Chimney Hill Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Chimney Hill Elementary the median was 40 days on the market, closing at 95.2% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 50 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Chimney Hill Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are T E Scott Elementary (0.7 km south), M B Sanford Elementary (0.9 km west) and Georges Vanier Elementary (1.4 km south-west).

Chimney Hill Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 14755 74 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Chimney Hill Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Chimney Hill Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Chimney Hill Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Chimney Hill Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 50 homes sold within 1 km of Chimney Hill Elementary: 41 houses, 5 townhomes and 3 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,480,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Chimney Hill Elementary

22 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Chimney Hill Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 4 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is T E Scott Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Green Timbers Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Frank Hurt Secondary (1.7 km); the nearest independent school is Regent Christian Academy (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: T E Scott Elementary (0.7 km south), M B Sanford Elementary (0.9 km west), Georges Vanier Elementary (1.4 km south-west), Janice Churchill Elementary (1.7 km north), Cornerstone Montessori School (2.0 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is T E Scott Elementary, 0.7 km south of Chimney Hill Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Chimney Hill Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Chimney Hill Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Chimney Hill Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Chimney Hill Elementary was $1,480,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at T E Scott Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south of Chimney Hill Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
